scenarios.name: JOHNSON/MIKE MR
speech: I'm travelling with my surfboard today.
Will there be an additional charge for oversized baggage?

scenarios.name: GARCIA/MARIA MS
speech: I'd like to keep my backpack with me during the flight.
Will it fit in the overhead compartment?

scenarios.name: SMITH/DAVID MR
speech: I seem to have misplaced my baggage receipt.
Will I still be able to collect my suitcase?

scenarios.name: WILSON/MARGARET MRS
speech: I only have 30 minutes to catch my next flight.
Is it possible for my suitcase to be unloaded first?

scenarios.name: ANDERSON/EMMA MS
speech: I've been told oversized baggage is usually delivered last.

scenarios.name: BROWN/THOMAS MR
speech: This package contains a very delicate antique vase.
Could you please mark it as fragile?

scenarios.name: LEE/DAVID MR
speech: Everyone else has already collected their baggage.

scenarios.name: MARTINEZ/ISABEL MS
speech: I arrived this morning from New York.
I've been informed my baggage will arrive on a later flight.

scenarios.name: CLARK/JAMES MR
speech: Will I need to pay for excess baggage?
